components.css: .ds-nav{font-family:'DM Sans Variable',sans-serif;font-size:18px;line-height:1.65;color:var(--ink,#2b2d28);display:flex;gap:26px;font-size:14.76px}.ds-nav a{color:inherit;text-decoration-color:#b2b6a8;text-underline-offset:.2em;text-decoration-thickness:1px;transition:color 140ms ease,text-decoration-color 140ms ease;color:var(--muted,#72736a);text-decoration:none;padding:5px 0}.ds-nav a:hover{color:var(--ink,#2b2d28)}.ds-nav a[aria-current="page"]{color:var(--ink,#2b2d28);text-decoration:underline;text-decoration-color:var(--accent,#526640);text-underline-offset:.5em}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#526640);outline-offset:5px;border-radius:2px;}@media(max-width:600px){.ds-nav{gap:17px;font-size:12.92px}.ds-nav a{padding:10px 0}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-nav a{transition:none}}

narrative.overview: A simple, understated, slightly modern personal website, informed by Steph Ango’s reading-focused site. Warm paper, dark type, generous margins, and a restrained olive accent keep attention on the writing. The visual structure comes from typography, whitespace, and plain lists.
keyCharacteristics: Warm neutrals with small olive details.
Flat surfaces and fine horizontal rules.
Familiar text links and restrained state changes.

rules.name: The Sparse Accent Rule
rules.body: Use olive for small reading and interaction cues; keep the page’s large surfaces paper-colored.

dos: Do preserve the narrow reading measure and responsive gutters.
Do distinguish reading hierarchy through type, spacing, and fine rules.
Do retain visible keyboard focus and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't introduce a marketing hero or portfolio/work-history cards.
Don't turn lists or topics into raised cards or filled pills.
Don't add decorative shadows, large accent surfaces, or an unrelated display font.
